title: Chanan ben Avishalom
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: The form Avishalom, not Avshalom, is the reading Hyman cites from Tosafot on Yoma 38b. He was one of Jerusalem’s judges of penalties during the Temple period. At the beginning of Mishnah Ketubot, chapter 13: “Two judges of penalties were in Jerusalem, Admon and Chanan ben Avishalom.” Chanan rules, “She shall swear at the end.” Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai endorses Chanan; the sons of the high priests disagree with him on both rulings.

notes.text: The person who swears is the wife claiming maintenance. The complete Mishnah has sons of high priests in the plural. The form Avishalom follows the notice’s heading and cited Tosafot reading.
